implemented.purpose: assemble length-varying single examples into one right-padded micro-batch
implemented.returns: three 2-D lists (input_ids, labels, attention_mask) plus batch-level audit fields; no tensors, no files written, inputs unmodified

core_risk_addressed.wrong_implementation: deriving valid positions from input_ids != pad_token_id
core_risk_addressed.consequence: every real EOS is classified as padding, so its label becomes -100 and its mask becomes 0; training still converges numerically but never learns to stop
core_risk_addressed.correct_implementation: validity comes only from attention_mask and labels
core_risk_addressed.regression_test: test_real_eos_is_not_masked_despite_sharing_id_with_pad asserts per sample that the supervised region still ends with a visible EOS

second_hazard_addressed.explanation: each single example is already padded to a multiple of 8; appending on top of that would create two padding layers whose shared boundary cannot be recovered from ids because pad and eos share one id
second_hazard_addressed.resolution: recompute the true valid length as prompt_token_count + supervised_token_count, then re-pad from the clean region up to the batch width

batch_rules.batch_width: longest valid length rounded up to pad_multiple
batch_rules.padding_side_dependency: all assertions assume right padding, where every valid region is a contiguous prefix; switching to left padding would require rewriting this function and prediction_position

preconditions_validated_not_corrected: sample_id must be unique inside the batch
each single example's own padding must form one contiguous trailing segment (mask=0 and labels=-100)
the supervised region must contain no negative labels
an untruncated example's supervised region must end with EOS, judged from labels rather than ids

paper_basis.appendix_c1_c2: max 512 tokens, truncate over-long, pad short samples to a multiple of 8

not_run: attention masking correctness inside a real Qwen forward
data to micro-batch assembly entry point
optimizer state and RNG checkpoint resume

pending_decision_carried_over.detail: 10000 samples do not divide into groups of 64; the last group of each epoch holds 2 micro-batches; error/step/drop must be chosen before formal training
